plugin.name: The Warriors Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)
skip.description: Skip the startup logos and the opening movie. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
fps.description: Choose 30 FPS or the experimental 60 FPS patch. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
aspect.description: Auto follows PPSSPP's display aspect. Enter W:H or a decimal (1:1 to 4:1) to override it. The 3D view keeps its vertical field of view on wider screens and its full width on narrower ones. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
fov.description: Scale the 3D field of view from 0.5 to 2.0. 1.0 keeps the game's own angles. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
hudaspect.description: Auto places side HUD elements, such as the radar and tutorial messages, at the screen edges. A ratio keeps them in a centered box (4:3 to 32:9). Menus stay centered. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
loading.description: Speeds up level loading screens. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
DualAnalogPatch.description: Use the right stick for the camera and keep the left stick for movement. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
language.description: Choose the language used for plugin patch notices. Auto uses English.
